space4all_model.name: SPACE4ALL (University of Twente), city-scale flood hazard modelled with FASTFLOOD, Nairobi
space4all_model.terms: CC BY 4.0. A simplified model of one 10-12 hour storm that ignores drains and culverts and was not calibrated.

space4all_report.name: SPACE4ALL, Diagnostic of Urban Flooding in Nairobi: Report 2024
space4all_report.terms: Names Mathare, Kibera and Korogocho as disproportionately affected.

wri_brief.name: WRI, Flooding in Nairobi's Informal Settlements (issue brief, 2026)
wri_brief.terms: Names Mathare, Mukuru and Kibera among the hardest hit in 2024; surveyed Mukuru Viwandani.

desinventar.name: DesInventar Sendai, Kenya disaster loss database (KEN-DLD)
desinventar.terms: Owned by the contributing Kenyan institutions; shared publicly with a request for citation.

reports.terms: Summarised in FloodSafe's own words, with a link to each report.
